threads.body: `defaultEnabled()` currently ignores the agent-wide default instrumentation enablement (`otel.instrumentation.common.default-enabled` via `super.defaultEnabled()`). As written, this module will be enabled whenever v3 preview is off, even if a distribution/user has globally disabled instrumentations by default. Consider composing with the superclass behavior (e.g., `super.defaultEnabled() && !AgentCommonConfig.get().isV3Preview()`) so global defaults are respected while still disabling in v3 preview.
